shell.verifyEmailBanner: Your email address is not verified yet. Open the verification link we sent you.

validation.emailInvalid: That is not a valid email address.
validation.emailTooLong: That email address is too long.
validation.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: Password must be at most 72 characters.
validation.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match.
validation.displayNameTooLong: That display name is too long.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Carry on building and preserving your family record.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: It takes a minute, and you can start straight away.
register.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. Pick something you will remember and nobody else would guess.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email. If it has an account, we will send a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Changing it ends every session currently signed in to this account.
reset.signsOutEverywhere: This signs your account out on every device.
reset.missingTokenBody: The reset link has no token in it. Request a new one.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.successBody: Thank you. Your account is ready.
verify.failedBody: That link is not valid, or it has expired.
verify.missingToken: The verification link has no token in it.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: How you appear to others, the language of the interface, and where you are signed in.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: The browsers and devices currently signed in to this account.

logoutAll.title: Security
logoutAll.heading: Sign out everywhere
logoutAll.body: Ends every session, including this one. Use it if you think someone else has access to your account.
logoutAll.confirmBody: You will have to sign in again everywhere, including here.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.emailAlreadyRegistered: That email address already has an account.
errors.validationFailed: Some of what you entered is not valid.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You may not perform this action.
errors.server: The server is having trouble. Try again shortly.

health.title: System health
health.subtitle: This page calls the server directly, through the same network layer the whole application uses.
health.hint: Check that the API is running with the dev profile and that PostgreSQL is up.

error.unexpectedBody: This section could not be displayed. Reload the page.
